# peernode_kubernetes_cluster (Resource)

A managed Kubernetes cluster on PeerNode provider machines (one vcluster per cluster). `autopilot` (default) pays for what the pods request, up to an optional cap; `auto` reserves a size and places it where convenient; `pools` reserves `count × (cpu, memory, disk)` nodes. The mode and the name cannot change in place; sizes can (resizing does not restart the cluster).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Autopilot (default): pay for what the pods request. The cap is optional.
resource "peernode_kubernetes_cluster" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

# Autopilot with a spending cap.
resource "peernode_kubernetes_cluster" "capped" {
  name      = "capped"
  autopilot = { max_cpu = 2, max_memory_gb = 4, max_disk_gb = 10 }
}

# Auto: a reserved size, placed wherever convenient.
resource "peernode_kubernetes_cluster" "api" {
  name = "api"
  mode = "auto"
  auto = { cpu = 2, memory_gb = 4, disk_gb = 20 }
}

# Node pools: count × (cpu, memory, disk). The first pool is the default.
resource "peernode_kubernetes_cluster" "batch" {
  name = "batch"
  mode = "pools"
  pools = [
    { name = "general", count = 2, cpu = 1, memory_gb = 2, disk_gb = 10 },
    { name = "big", count = 1, cpu = 4, memory_gb = 8 },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Cluster name (lowercase letters, digits and dashes). Changing it replaces the cluster.

### Optional

- `auto` (Attributes) Auto mode only: the cluster size, reserved on provider machines and paid for by the hour. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auto))
- `autopilot` (Attributes) Autopilot mode only: a cap on what the cluster's pods may request together. When omitted the platform default applies (shown after apply). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autopilot))
- `mode` (String) `autopilot` (default), `auto` or `pools`. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `pools` (Attributes List) Pools mode only: 1-5 node pools; the first is the default for pods that do not select one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `hourly_micro` (Number) Price of the reserved size per hour in micro-credits (0 for autopilot, which pays for use).
- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `public_hosts` (List of String) Public HTTPS hostnames (set once the cluster has a LoadBalancer service).
- `size_cpu_milli` (Number) The most the pods may request: CPU, millicores.
- `size_disk_bytes` (Number) Volumes, bytes.
- `size_memory_bytes` (Number) The most the pods may request: memory, bytes.
- `status` (String) `provisioning`, `ready`, `failed` or `deleting`.

<a id="nestedatt--auto"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auto`

Required:

- `cpu` (Number) CPU cores (0.5-256).
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory, GiB (0.5-1024).

Optional:

- `disk_gb` (Number) Persistent volumes, GiB.
- `min_pod_cpu` (Number) Guarantee one part of the reservation at least this big (CPU cores).
- `min_pod_memory_gb` (Number) Guarantee one part of the reservation at least this big (memory, GiB).


<a id="nestedatt--autopilot"></a>
### Nested Schema for `autopilot`

Required:

- `max_cpu` (Number) CPU cores.
- `max_disk_gb` (Number) Persistent volumes, GiB.
- `max_memory_gb` (Number) Memory, GiB.


<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Required:

- `count` (Number) Nodes (1-10).
- `cpu` (Number) CPU cores per node (0.25-64).
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory per node, GiB (0.25-256).
- `name` (String) Pool name (`nodeSelector: {peernode.cloud/pool: <name>}`).

Optional:

- `disk_gb` (Number) Persistent volumes per node, GiB.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peernode_kubernetes_cluster.web <cluster id>
```
